overview.description: The Touchstone Sands Capital Emerging Markets ex-China Growth ETF (TEMX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is actively managed, investing in equity securities of emerging and frontier market companies, excluding China and Hong Kong. The fund targets long-term growth through a bottom-up approach, focusing on strong earnings potential, industry leadership, and ESG factors TEMX was launched on Feb 24, 2025 and is issued by Touchstone.
